headline: Elphidran drop boost
title: Elphidran | Flying Mount With Dark Drop Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Farming Dark Pals for drops in Palworld one point zero? Elphidran is a Dragon Pal you can ride as a flying mount, and its partner skill, Amicable Holy Dragon, makes Dark Pals drop forty to eighty percent more items when defeated while it is in your party. At base it works Lumbering level three. Will you use Elphidran? Comment below!
description: Elphidran in Palworld 1.0 is a Dragon flying mount that boosts Dark Pal drops and works Lumbering level three.
